name: OwnTracks
tagline: Privacy-focused location tracking via HTTP and MQTT
description: OwnTracks is an open-source location sharing protocol and ecosystem for personal and small-fleet tracking. Mobile apps publish location updates over MQTT or HTTP; backends and tools consume a documented JSON message format for live position, history, and geofencing.

auth.details: Self-hosted: MQTT username/password or HTTP basic/auth as configured on your OwnTracks recorder or broker. No central OwnTracks cloud API key.

pricing.free_tier_limits: Open-source self-hosted software; no paid cloud API from OwnTracks. Costs are your own server/broker hosting.

rate_limits: not published (depends on self-hosted recorder/broker configuration)
use_cases: publish a device location update to a self-hosted OwnTracks recorder over HTTP
parse OwnTracks JSON location messages from MQTT for a private map
ingest transition/geofence enter-leave events from OwnTracks apps
build a privacy-first family or fleet tracker without a third-party cloud
